what: the bounded experiment of the acceptance (item C): 252 configurations from one sentence, run through the application on engine 7.0.1

experiment.title: Buy ATM SPY calls at 10:00 AM Eastern after a 0.5% down day, from 2024-01-18 to 2026-11-25

base.title: Buy ATM SPY calls at 10:00 AM Eastern after a 0.5% down day, from 2024-01-18 to 2026-11-25

dims.text: entry times from 9:30 to 11:00 in 15-minute increments

notes: "several profit targets" names none: 25%, 50% and 100% of the premium are assumed.
No step was given for the decline: 0.5% is assumed.
No time zone was stated: the entry times are read as Eastern time and shown in New York time.

stability.text: The highest expectancy is 10:45, 1DTE, 100%, 2%: +190.95 a trade; with the 6 configurations next to it the figure ranges down to +36.37. The most stable region is around 10:45, 1DTE, 50%, 2.5%: the cell and its 6 neighbours all make at least +56.96 a trade (mean +90.87).

experiment.observation: trade prints (no bid/ask): a fill is the last print the engine had seen, with the run's slippage assumption

summary.text: 252 of 252 configurations traded. 213 of them (84.5%) end above zero; the median result is +1,020.80. The best, 09:45, 1DTE, 50%, 0.5%, made +8,927.05 over 143 trades (t +2.81; as the best of 252 configurations that is p = 1.00 after adjusting for the search, 0.005 before). Chosen on the earlier sessions alone, the best would have been 10:45, 1DTE, 100%, 1.5% (+287.30 a trade over 27 trades before 2026-01-20); on the later sessions it made -130.12 a trade over 14. Across the 126 configurations with enough trades in both parts, the ranking by the earlier part and by the later part correlate at -0.56: the ranking tends to REVERSE: what looked better earlier mostly looked worse later. Coverage ranges from 99.3% to 100% of the signals: configurations are not all tested on the same sessions. Both parts are history that has now been examined; neither is evidence of an edge.
